title: Close tasks with an optional comment in one command
description:
## Intent

As an AI agent or Kanbus user, I want to close a task and record its closing note in one command, so completion history is not lost when a two-command sequence is skipped or fails midway.

Canonical command: `kbs close <id> --comment "Completed and verified."`

## Definition of Done

- Gherkin behavior specifications define the feature first.
- Python and Rust implement identical observable behavior.
- CLI help, documentation, and agent guidance match the delivered command.
- Python tests, Rust tests, and spec-parity validation pass.

## Product decision

When `--comment` is supplied, validate and persist a normal comment, emit normal comment hooks, then attempt normal close and hooks. This is sequential, not transactional: a bad comment leaves the issue untouched; a close failure after comment success leaves the comment and issue unclosed. Plain `close <id>` remains unchanged.

## Out of scope

No schema, API, console UI, comment-type, migration, transactional rollback, or advanced standalone-comment options added to `close`.
right_now_summary: The implementation is ready for review and merge.
